**BLOCKERS:**

6. `pages/company/CompanyJobCandidates.tsx:362-381` — 3 botões icon-only (chat/descartar/aprovar) só com `title=`. Adicione `aria-label` em cada.
7. `pages/company/CompanyJobCandidates.tsx:594` — textarea de review com `<label>` sem `htmlFor`/`id`. Associe.
8. `pages/company/CompanyWallet.tsx:138` — sombra offset com alpha 0.2 → `rgba(0,0,0,1)` (sólida).
9. `components/PaymentMethodsSection.tsx:113` — `border` (1px) → `border-2`.

**MENORES (corrija também, são triviais):**
10. `components/PaymentMethodsSection.tsx:187` — remova `export { Loader2 }` (re-export inútil).
11. `components/PaymentMethodsSection.tsx:164` — badge `rounded-lg` → `rounded-xl` ou `rounded-full`.
